title: CRM project management
html:
To carry out project management, the Project management type has to be selected when the project is created:

After the project has been created, the Project management tab appears on the home page:

Within Project management, further records can be opened by clicking the button. The process and the status of the record are visible on the home page. On the new record form, select the template and fill in the basic data:

The record created can be opened with the button. The opened record shows the template, the various views and the project data:

The tasks can be edited with the pencil button and deleted with the bin sign. The New task button creates a new task. An owner, a level, a timeline and a description can be assigned to the task, and a file can also be attached.

In the task list, clicking the bubble lets you add a comment or attach a file:

In the Kanban view, the tasks can be dragged from one status to another:

The history is at the bottom of the record. In the Gantt view, the timeline entered is displayed:
